material_findings.title: External A2A protocol version is not pinned
material_findings.evidence: The contract records AIDE compatibility/schema protocolVersion 0.1.0 but no target_a2a_protocol_version 1.0 or target_a2a_specification_release 1.0.0 field was found.
material_findings.repair_direction: Add explicit external A2A protocol and specification-release pins distinct from AIDE schema/contract/agent implementation versions.

material_findings.title: Projected Agent Card omits supportedInterfaces
material_findings.evidence: agent-card.preview.json does not contain supportedInterfaces while being emitted as an Agent Card projection.
material_findings.repair_direction: Either emit no official AgentCard until an endpoint/fixture interface is coherent, or emit a standards-clean non-live fixture/template with supportedInterfaces[].

material_findings.title: Legacy top-level url placeholder is emitted as null
material_findings.evidence: agent-card.preview.json contains top-level url: null; A2A v1.0 moved endpoint URL into supportedInterfaces[0].url.
material_findings.repair_direction: Remove top-level url from any official v1.0 AgentCard object and represent non-live endpoint state outside the official card.

material_findings.title: Provider object has null required URL
material_findings.evidence: provider is present with organization AIDE and url null; A2A AgentProvider requires both organization and url when provider is present.
material_findings.repair_direction: Omit provider or provide a valid non-secret documentation/organization URL in the official card.

material_findings.title: Extended-card capability uses legacy top-level field
material_findings.evidence: supportsAuthenticatedExtendedCard is emitted at the top level; A2A v1.0 places extendedAgentCard under capabilities.
material_findings.repair_direction: Use capabilities.extendedAgentCard false/omitted for v1.0, or isolate legacy metadata outside the official card.

material_findings.title: Unsupported stateTransitionHistory capability is emitted as A2A capability
material_findings.evidence: capabilities.stateTransitionHistory appears in the projected Agent Card even though the pinned v1.0 capability model contains streaming, pushNotifications, extensions, and extendedAgentCard.
material_findings.repair_direction: Move AIDE future/task-state metadata outside the official AgentCapabilities object.

material_findings.title: AIDE governance fields are embedded inside AgentSkill objects
material_findings.evidence: Each skill contains aide_operation_mapping, implemented, requires_future_capability_grant, requires_future_policy_decision, and side_effect_class inside the AgentSkill object.
material_findings.repair_direction: Separate official AgentSkill fields from an AIDE skill governance catalogue keyed by skill id.

material_findings.title: Unimplemented skills are advertised in an externally shaped skills array
material_findings.evidence: The official-looking skills array lists four skills but all are implemented:false and no endpoint, task delegation, or worker execution exists; conforming clients may ignore implemented:false.
material_findings.repair_direction: Keep official skills empty until callable, or mark the card as non-publishable template and keep candidate skills in AIDE metadata.

warnings: No vendored complete official A2A JSON Schema validation exists; this check used bounded independent field validation against the current public A2A 1.0 documentation.

A2A remains contract-only and projection-only; no endpoint, registration, authentication, task delegation, worker execution, provider/model/network call, runtime, host integration, or mutation behavior exists.
The build's runtime and AIDE authority boundaries are preserved despite standards-alignment defects.
